run_product_quantization: run product quantization on a pretrained ResNet model to compress weights using PQ centroids
quantize_resnet_layerwise: quantize a pretrained ResNet18 or ResNet50 model layer by layer with configurable block sizes and centroids
finetune_centroids_layerwise: finetune quantization centroids layer-wise using CentroidSGD optimizer with a teacher-student distillation setup
finetune_compressed_whole_network: finetune the entire compressed quantized network globally using CentroidSGD over multiple epochs
save_compressed_model: save the compressed model state dict including quantized centroids, assignments, and non-quantized layers
